Name: Goosey Geese
Author: emjess
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45791]Geese Unification Project[/url] and my pet hatred of the SVE goose, I present unified goose sprites for Mizu's Goose and Visit Mount Vapius! 

[b]There are two (2) files: one that reskins Mizu's Goose and one that reskins Visit Mount Vapius goose and stellar goose. You can have either one, or both.  [/b]

1) Goosey Geese - Mizu 
- reskins all options for Mizu's Goose, including babies. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45160]Mizu's Goose[/url]. 

2) Goosey Geese - VMV
- reskins the goose and stellar goose from Lumisteria's Visit Mount Vapius, including babies. Config option to change the stellar goose to a black goose that's more void inspired. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url].

[b]Requirements[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45160]Mizu's Goose[/url] - Mizu version
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url] - for VMV version 

[b]Install [/b]
Download and extract the appropriate file(s) to your mods folder.
You can install one or both files depending on which goose mods you have and want to reskin. 

[b]Notes[/b]
- Original sprites, meant to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]. I've also been enjoying the geese walking around with their big bird friends [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33306]Tremendous Turkeys[/url].
- babies are a little large, but I sketched the shape in like 10 minutes and it turn out so angry little gosling shaped that i'm keeping it
-  Does not actually do anything to the SVE goose. I tried, it's just too small to get the goosey shape I wanted. Just ends up looking like a duck. May revisit in the future.
